howto.what: 它把 WhatsApp Cloud 适配器从 channels 分支复制进 src/channels/,追加一行注册导入、安装固定版本依赖,并跑构建与注册测试,让 NanoClaw 接入 Meta 官方 WhatsApp Business Cloud API。

howto.what_en: It copies the WhatsApp Cloud adapter from the channels branch, adds its registration import, installs a pinned dependency, and runs build plus a registration test to wire NanoClaw to Meta's WhatsApp Business Cloud API.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to add the official Meta WhatsApp channel to NanoClaw, either during /setup or on its own.
